verdict.rationale:
Shopify's UCP documents a genuine least-privilege credential model: three trust tiers (Token/Signed/Anonymous) gating access to sensitive tools, JWTs minted from Dev Dashboard client credentials with 60-minute TTL, checkout completion requiring a token 'granted permission to complete purchases', and Order MCP requiring a specific 'read_global_api_orders' scope unavailable to lower tiers. Signed-tier uses RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures with ECDSA P-256 keys tied to a published profile, giving cryptographic, scoped identification short of full API tokens.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of scope enforcement, documentation of credential revocation or fine-grained custom scopes beyond the few named ones.
